    word_set = set(word_dict)
    
    # Initialize the DP table
    dp = [[] for _ in range(len(s) + 1)]
    dp[0].append("")
    
    # Fill the DP table
    for i in range(1, len(s) + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            if s[j:i] in word_set and dp[j]:
                dp[i].extend([prefix + " " + s[j:i] for prefix in dp[j]])
    
    # Backtrack to get all sentences

        if index == 0:
            return [""]
        result = []
        for prefix in dp[index]:
            if prefix:
                result.extend(backtrack(j) + [prefix.strip()])
        return result
    
    # Get all sentences starting from the end of the string
    sentences = backtrack(len(s))
    
    # Sort the sentences lexicographically
    sentences.sort()
    
    return sentences
